image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a vertical traffic light suspended against a clear blue sky. The traffic light housing is dark gray/black with three circular lenses stacked vertically: red (top, illuminated), amber/yellow (middle, unlit but visible), and green (bottom, illuminated). Each lens has a textured, faceted surface typical of LED or prismatic lenses. Visors (hoods) extend over each lens. The unit is mounted to a horizontal mast arm via a bracket, with electrical wires visible above. To the left, a portion of another signal backplate or adjacent structure is visible.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific class identity and rule out misclassification as other street furniture or lights.
To verify the 3D structural integrity of the visors and ensure they do not melt into the housing or background, a common AI artifact.
To check for clean boundaries between the lenses and the housing, and ensure the mounting hardware is physically connected without fusion artifacts.

focus_areas: Lens hood geometry and connection to housing
Color accuracy and separation of red/amber/green
Texture consistency of the housing vs. lenses
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the junction where the visors meet the main housing body. AI generators often struggle with the thin, protruding geometry of visors, causing them to appear fused or warped. Also, inspect the 'unlit' amber lens; ensure it has physical depth and texture rather than appearing as a flat painted circle. Verify that the mounting bracket at the top logically connects to the mast arm without floating or impossible geometry.
